race.comment: SOTOMAYOR (2) has had two runs since a two-month let-up and a change of stable, the latest a tidy effort over 1400m at Warrnambool where he worked home well in a stronger race than this. Cherry ripe now and his best form comes at this distance. Perfectly poised to return to the winner's list. NEWCOMBE (3) was shuffled back to near the tail then rallied late to finish fourth last time out over 1700m at Warrnambool. Down in grade and can travel a bit closer from the inside gate. Just one win in 26 is the knock. TUDAYA (7) hasn't won for 500 days. Nice effort over this trip at Penola last time and the addition of blinkers might add some spark. BATTLE POINT (8) can improve over this longer trip after a modest first-up performance at Kilmore. SWEATER GIRL (10) needed the run at Bendigo las time, the first in two months. Has a strong record at this trip so must be considered.
